Name: Downtown Zuzu
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
So you're playing some Stardew Valley, and someone mentions the infamous "Zuzu City". This city is mentioned all through the game, haven't you ever wondered what it is like?

[b]NOTE: Zuzu is currently in early beta! Not all areas will be fully fleshed out yet, and there are still some known bugs (however, the mod is still most definitely playable). Updated to SDV 1.6.9!
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Vi6q4Ki.png[/img][/center][/b]
Welcome to the bustling heart of Stardew Valley - Downtown Zuzu! This electrifying mod injects an explosion of excitement into your sleepy farm life. Prepare yourself for a whirlwind adventure packed with new features, characters, and quirky surprises! Say goodbye to the mundane farming life and say hello to skyscrapers, fancy cafes, and a city vibe that'll make even the Junimos do the hustle! This incredible mod brings urban excitement and a dose of chaos to your beloved farming sim. The city is accessible in many ways - on the bus via BusLocations, via the train, or via the sewers!


[size=4][b][u]Explore the Vibrant Downtown[/u][/b][/size]
Say goodbye to mundane routines and hello to a vibrant urban landscape! Downtown Zuzu introduces a whole new district, complete with sparkling shops, dazzling arcades, and mouthwatering eateries. Immerse yourself in the lively ambiance and uncover secrets in every nook and cranny.

[b][u][size=4]Meet Eccentric Characters[/size]
[/u][/b]Get ready to forge unique friendships and form unforgettable bonds! Encounter a cast of eccentric characters who call Downtown Zuzu their home. With plenty city-folk around, love is in the air! Amp up your dating game and prepare for a whirlwind of romance options. Will you go for the sophisticated city slicker, or is your heart set on that pizza chef? From the quirky CEO of Joja Corporation, to chefs-turned-adventurers - there is no shortage of friendly and likeable NPCs in Zuzu City!

[size=4][b][u]Pursue Thrilling Quests[/u][/b][/size]
Adventure awaits! Downtown Zuzu is brimming with thrilling quests that will keep you on your toes. Embark on daring missions in the city's dark, dank sewer system, and find treasures beyond your wildest dreams in puzzles galore. Dive head first into the terrifying caves of the Zuzu Oasis, filled to the brim with bountiful loot, but also deadly creatures awaiting your entry. Your journey promises heaps of laughter and unexpected rewards!

[b][u][size=4]Unearth Hidden Treasures[/size][/u][/b]
As you explore this urban paradise, you'll stumble upon hidden treasures and ancient artifacts. Who knows what valuable relics the city has to offer? Legend says that deep in the bowls of the city is an ancient puzzle, withholding troves and troves of treasure!
And hey, remember, always check a chest twice! You never know what you might find. ;)

[b][u][size=4]New Festivals and Events[/size][/u][/b]
Get ready to party like never before! Downtown Zuzu will introduce an array of festivals and events that'll have you dancing, crafting, and competing like a pro. The nightlife scene is particularly enticing, offering gallons of activities in the Zuzu Underground Nightclub.

[b][u][size=4]Build Fresh Connections[/size][/u][/b]
Downtown Zuzu is a hub of social interaction. Attend exclusive events, mingle with the locals, and maybe even find love in this vibrant community. The mod lets you deepen your relationships and experience heartwarming moments with your favorite characters.

[b][u][size=4]Progression[/size][/u][/b]
We know you crave that sense of progression, and Downtown Zuzu delivers big time! As you grow your friendships, watch the city evolve, and seize opportunities to make your mark. Take charge of fixing dilapidated sawmills, breathe life into broken-down greenhouses, and hey, how about owning an apartment? The city is your oyster, and we've got your back.

[b][u][size=4]Shopping[/size][/u][/b]
Shopaholics, rejoice! Downtown Zuzu is a paradise for shopaholics like you. Whether you're in the mood for Joja's shiny aisles, the warmth of family bakeries, or some pharmacy retail therapy, we've got it all! Prepare to shop 'til you drop in the city's vibrant marketplace.
[b][u][size=4]
Travel[/size][/u][/b]
Dreaming of a tropical getaway? How about flying to the Kahuna Resort via the swanky Zuzu International Airport? Buckle up and enjoy a custom flight cutscene that whisks you away to a beautiful island full of custom fish, gems, and forage!

[b][u][size=4]Music[/size][/u][/b]
Over 20 new songs are added to the game with the mod! Nearly all of these songs were created in collaboration with Video Game Music Lounge (VGML)![url=https://vgm.datagecko.com/gamedev/downtown-zuzu] Listen to the tracks and support them on Bandcamp here![/url]

[b][u][size=4]And More Surprises![/size][/u][/b]
Downtown Zuzu is full of delightful surprises that will keep you hooked for hours. From quirky Easter eggs to unexpected encounters, this mod keeps the thrill alive and ensures you'll never get bored in Stardew Valley again! Picture this: a Bus Stop area instantly welcoming you to the city, a "Joja Mini" mart for your shopping needs, a bustling crossroads area, and even a freeway interchange that leads right into the desert! You'll also find a hidden oasis-like sanctuary, Joja HQ (watch out for corporate shenanigans!), and an adorable cafe tucked away inside the sanctuary area. And that's not all - we've got an underground sewer area (pre-bus unlock accessible), a secret spot featuring everyone's favorite blue-skinned lad (you know who we mean), and a loot-filled cave with some spine-tingling challenges. Oh, don't forget the mysterious forest! Feel like taking a train ride? Hop on at the new train station and explore even more! Trust us, there are countless other surprises waiting for you...



By the way, we've got some awesome news! Downtown Zuzu is fully compatible with all major expansion mods like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, Walk to the Desert: Redux, and more! It's a seamless integration that guarantees you'll have the time of your virtual life.
Don't be shy! Join our friendly Discord server to become a part of our awesome community, stay up-to-date with development, and have some extra fun with like-minded players. Feeling more social? You can also join our subreddit!

Oh, and one last thing - Downtown Zuzu is fully integrated with Walk to the Desert Redux! Just head down the bottom exit of the Zuzu City freeway map, and you'll be whisked away to the captivating "Custom_WTDR_Interchange" map.


So there you have it, folks! Downtown Zuzu is waiting for you with open arms, ready to immerse you in the thrilling world of urban Stardew Valley. It's time to embrace the chaos, seize the city, and embark on an unforgettable adventure. Dive into the bustling charm of Downtown Zuzu, and let the excitement begin! Whether you're a seasoned farmer or a fresh-faced newbie, this mod is sure to spice up your virtual farming life in ways you never imagined. Let's go! See you in Zuzu!

[b]A world of possibilities...
